title: Tokyo food and coffee: 10 places to try
desc: Restaurants, markets, cafés and sweet shops around Tokyo, including Shibuya, Ebisu, Tsukiji and Ginza, grouped into food and coffee.

items.title: Dogenzaka Mammoth (道玄坂マンモス)
items.memo: Restaurant in the Dogenzaka area of Shibuya.

items.title: Hikiniku to Come, Shibuya (挽肉と米 渋谷)
items.memo: Popular hamburg steak and rice set grilled over charcoal; expect a queue.

items.title: Ebisu Sushi Hatsume
items.memo: Omakase sushi counter in Ebisu; book ahead.

items.title: Tsukiji Outer Market (築地場外市場)
items.memo: Seafood and street-food stalls; go in the morning, many shops close by early afternoon.

items.title: Menya Sign
items.memo: Noodle shop; good for a casual bowl.

items.title: Atelier Matcha
items.memo: Matcha-focused café for drinks and sweets.

items.title: Bongen Coffee Ginza
items.memo: Small specialty coffee shop in Ginza.

items.title: Age.3 Ginza
items.memo: Ginza shop known for fried cream-filled buns.
